name: User Restrictions
description: Specifies rules for restricting users allowed access to a site.
project_description: User Restrictions lets administrators define rules that refuse (or explicitly allow) account registration, login, and profile edits based on the entered username, the entered email address, or the client IP address. It is the Drupal 8+ replacement for the "access rules" feature removed from Drupal 7 core. Each rule is a configuration entity holding a regular-expression pattern, a restriction type plugin (username, email, or client IP), an allow/reject flag, the set of user forms it applies to, and an optional expiration time. Rules are enforced as validation handlers added to the user register, login, and edit forms; accounts holding the "bypass user restrictions" permission are exempt. The restriction types are pluggable, so third-party modules can add new kinds of restriction. Rules match case-insensitively and the pattern is used directly as a PCRE regular expression, so wildcard/complex matching is expressed with regex syntax.
